sources.title: Original NVIDIA NeMo model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact 70B Instruct model, NVIDIA customization of Llama 3.1 through REINFORCE RLHF for general instruction following, Transformer architecture, text input/output, 128k input, and the current NVIDIA plus Llama license notices. Reopened October 27: the base_model field and training description explicitly identify meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct as the initial REINFORCE policy; the network architecture remains Llama 3.1.

sources.title: NVIDIA Transformers conversion model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies this checkpoint as NVIDIA’s format conversion of the original NeMo model, rather than a later Nemotron variant; provides downloadable Transformers inference instructions. Reopened October 27: repeats the exact Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct initial-policy lineage and describes only a format conversion, without a new modality or architecture.

sources.title: Official HF checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM with 80 layers, hidden size 8192, intermediate size 28672, 64 query heads, 8 KV heads, vocabulary 128256, untied embeddings, BF16, and 131072 maximum positions. No quantization or MoE configuration. Reopened October 27; _name_or_path names meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, corroborating the unchanged dense policy architecture described by the alignment paper.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Indexes 723 tensors across 30 safetensors shards; reports 141107412992 data bytes. Every indexed tensor was matched exactly once against the shard headers.

sources.title: Official safetensors headers (first of 30 indexed shards)
sources.evidence: Requested bytes 0–65535 from each of the 30 indexed shards, required HTTP 206, parsed each 8-byte little-endian header length and JSON. All 723 entries are BF16 learned weight matrices or norms; their shape products sum to 70553706496. No buffers, quantization scales or packed tensors occur.

sources.title: Official HF repository metadata
sources.evidence: Identifies revision 031d4042f36adc1a52cca51b331d25cbe3cf1022 and independently reports 70553706496 BF16 safetensors parameters. Creation timestamp 2024-10-12 is repository metadata, not proof of public release. Reopened October 27: the same revision and exact BF16 total are still reported; this independently corroborates the prior census without rereading any weight shard.

sources.title: Original NeMo configuration
sources.evidence: Original model also specifies 131072 maximum positions, 80 layers, 8192 hidden size, 28672 FFN size, 64 attention heads, 8 query groups, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE and untied embeddings; fp8 is false.

sources.title: Original NeMo weight metadata
sources.evidence: Read all nine original NeMo .zarray files: BF16 weight arrays total 70566289408 elements. Input and output vocabulary matrices each have 129024 rows versus 128256 in the HF conversion; the difference is 2*(129024-128256)*8192=12582912 padded elements.

sources.title: NVIDIA alignment-model announcement
sources.evidence: The article links the exact Instruct model and says it is accessible through NVIDIA’s service and Hugging Face. Its displayed publication date is 2024-10-03 but it explicitly records an update on 2024-10-21, so this establishes October 2024 availability without proving the original Instruct release day.

sources.title: HelpSteer2-Preference original paper version
sources.evidence: The 2024-10-02 abstract explicitly releases the Reward model and dataset, without the later Instruct-model release link. This date is not used as the Instruct release day.

sources.title: HelpSteer2-Preference revised technical report
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, including sections 5.2–5.3 and Appendix E: the released Instruct policy starts from Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct and is aligned with REINFORCE, using a separate reward model. The documented policy training introduces no pruning, expert expansion, additional modality or structural distillation; the linear reward head described in section 3 belongs to the separate reward model, not this Instruct policy. No active-count column or separate active-count specification for Nemotron 70B is supplied.

sources.title: Exact-model NVIDIA NIM system card
sources.evidence: The self-hosted NIM feature table explicitly marks Tool Calling unsupported. This is deployment-support evidence for this NVIDIA model identifier, not evidence that arbitrary prompting of the raw checkpoint cannot produce a call.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: The inherited Llama chat template accepts tool definitions and single function-call messages. That format support conflicts with treating the NVIDIA NIM endpoint as tool-enabled; it does not override the exact NIM system-card limitation.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement
sources.evidence: The actual agreement identified by the exact current model cards; its version date is June 14, 2024.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: The actual Llama 3.1 agreement additionally identified by the model card and explicitly accepted in the initial October 2024 card.

sources.title: Original October 2024 model-card text
sources.evidence: The October 12 committed card describes the same model and gives October 1 benchmark timing, not a release declaration. The initial license notice references Llama 3.1; current cards additionally name the NVIDIA Open Model License.

sources.title: AI21 Jamba-1.5 original ICLR 2025 paper, Table 1
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded October 27 and checked the complete Table 1 on printed page 5: its distinct Available params and Active params columns list Llama-3.1 70B as 70B and 70B. This is AI21’s nominal research-comparison convention for the named Llama 3.1 size, not a direct NVIDIA or Meta active-count disclosure and not an exact per-token tensor census.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3.1 model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: identifies pretrained and instruction-tuned Llama 3.1 models in the same 8B, 70B and 405B size classes, with an autoregressive Transformer architecture and SFT/RLHF for the tuned versions. Supports matching the Llama-3.1 70B comparison row to the exact Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct initial policy named by NVIDIA; does not itself publish a separate active count.

license.value: NVIDIA Open Model License + Llama 3.1 Community License
license.note: Current exact cards explicitly name both agreements. Initial October 2024 card named Llama 3.1; its YAML still uses llama 3.1. This is a descriptive combined license value, not a claim of unrestricted licensing.

parameters_b.note: Complete official HF conversion: 70553706496 learned BF16 parameters in 723 tensors across 30 shards, including untied input/output embeddings and norms; no buffers/scales. Reproduce by summing each header shape product. Independent configuration formula: 2*128256*8192+80*(2*8192**2+2*8192*1024+3*8192*28672+2*8192)+8192. Original NeMo stores 70566289408 elements because both vocab matrices are padded to 129024 rows; 12582912 extra padded elements are not added to this HF count. 70B is nominal. October 27 re-audit preserves this previously verified census and separately reopens the original/conversion cards, configuration and official repository metadata, which still reports the same revision and exact BF16 count; no weight shards were requested.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference from AI21’s original Jamba-1.5 ICLR Table 1, which explicitly reports 70B active parameters for Llama-3.1 70B. Meta identifies the base and instruction-tuned releases in that same 70B class; NVIDIA’s exact cards and alignment paper identify Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct as this model’s initial REINFORCE policy. The reopened configuration and documented training retain the Llama 3.1 architecture, with no policy pruning, expert expansion, added modality or structural distillation. The reward model and its scoring head are separate training components. This transfers AI21’s published nominal active-count convention through documented post-training lineage; it does not equate the precise 70.553706496B HF total with active parameters or claim NVIDIA disclosed an exact per-token count. Fresh exact-card/paper and first-party searches found no separate NVIDIA active-count specification.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Llama 3.1 Transformer: 80 blocks, 64 query/8 KV heads, dense SwiGLU MLPs, RMSNorm and RoPE. The full weight inventory contains no experts or router.

context_window.note: Both original NeMo and official HF configurations specify 131072 maximum positions; the cards use the rounded 128k label. This is the checkpoint limit; hosted deployments may impose lower limits.

modalities.note: Exact cards explicitly specify text input and text output.

reasoning.note: This is general RLHF instruction tuning, with no separately documented thinking mode or reasoning-budget control. The card’s example without additional reasoning tokens does not establish a model-wide negative capability claim; clear the unsupported false rather than transfer later Nemotron reasoning specifications.

tool_call.note: The exact NVIDIA NIM system card marks Tool Calling unsupported, while the downloadable checkpoint retains inherited Llama tool-call syntax. This catalog records model capability across deployments; neither a positive capability claim nor a model-wide negative is established for this fine-tune. Clear the baseline true and retain the deployment limitation in notes.

patch.description: NVIDIA’s RLHF-tuned Llama 3.1 70B Instruct model, trained with REINFORCE and HelpSteer2 preference data to improve helpfulness in general instruction following.
patch.notes: Total is the exact 70.553706496B complete BF16 NVIDIA Transformers conversion. The original NeMo checkpoint stores 70.566289408B elements, including 12,582,912 extra vocabulary-padding elements; 70B is nominal. Active is a nominal 70B lineage inference from AI21’s Jamba comparison convention for Llama 3.1 70B and NVIDIA’s documented REINFORCE post-training of Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct; NVIDIA does not separately disclose an exact active count. Release is established to October 2024, with the day unresolved. Context is 131072 tokens in both configurations. NVIDIA NIM marks tool calling unsupported, while the checkpoint retains inherited Llama function-call syntax; capability for the fine-tune remains unverified. Dedicated reasoning support is also unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the verified 70.553706496B HF total, freshly corroborated by official metadata for the same revision. Sets active parameters to nominal 70B using AI21’s explicit Llama-3.1 70B comparison convention and NVIDIA’s documented, structurally unchanged REINFORCE policy lineage. NVIDIA still does not separately disclose an exact active count. Preserves all twelve other field assessments and the distinction between original NeMo vocabulary padding and the HF conversion; no weight shards were requested.
